name: application-testimonial-card
title: Testimonial Card
description: Marketing testimonial card: a star rating, blockquote, and reviewer avatar with name and role.
useWhen: Displaying a customer quote or review as social proof on a marketing or pricing page.
You need a star rating paired with the quote and reviewer identity.
Distinct from Social Post Card, which shows a photo post with like/comment interactions rather than a quoted customer endorsement with a rating.
avoidWhen: The content is a social media post with likes/comments — use Social Post Card instead.
There's no rating to show — a plain quote/attribution block is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The quote wraps normally at any width; avatar and name/role stay aligned on one row via flex regardless of name length.
accessibility: The star row uses role="img" with an aria-label stating the numeric rating, since the visual star fill alone isn't announced by screen readers.
The quote is marked up as a real <blockquote>, and the avatar's alt text is the reviewer's name.

variants.title: Testimonial Card
variants.description: A 5-star rating, a customer quote, and a reviewer avatar with name and role.
accessibility: Star rating carries role="img" with a numeric aria-label.

variants.title: Testimonial Card (Dark)
variants.description: The same testimonial card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Star, quote, and reviewer text contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
